The report discusses the growing demand for **100% renewable energy use** in data centers, driven by investors, customers, and legislators. It highlights the shift from relying solely on renewable energy certificates to using **power purchase agreements (PPAs)** and other instruments. The report also explores the limitations of greenwashing risks and the role of energy storage solutions like large-scale battery deployments.
